description: This file defines a Flutter widget called PlayerIndicator, which displays the current player's turn, the game result, or a draw status for a Tic-Tac-Toe game. It visually shows the game state with themed colors and accessibility semantics.

classes.name: PlayerIndicator
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays the current game status including active player, winner, or a draw.

classes.name: _Dot
classes.description: A private StatelessWidget used to render a decorative colored dot indicating the current player or game status.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget UI, displaying the game status including the house name, winner, or current player, styled with theme colors and semantics.

methods.name: _Dot.build
methods.description: Builds the decorative dot widget with animated color and box shadow.
